They build relationships with customers, understand their businesses, lead projects and help them make better technology decisions. We’re looking for an experienced engineer who can combine deep technical capability with consulting, project leadership and clear communication . Kodo Technologies is a South Australian technology and cybersecurity company providing managed IT, cloud, cybersecurity, governance and strategic technology services to businesses, local government and community organisations. What You’ll Do You’ll work closely with customers to understand their business, their technology environment and where they want to go. You’ll: Build strong customer relationships and become a trusted technology adviser . Lead regular business and technology reviews, helping customers identify risks, opportunities and priorities. Turn business needs into practical technology roadmaps, recommendations and projects . Scope, manage and deliver technology projects from initial discussion through to implementation and handover. Provide senior technical support and solve complex problems that require experience and judgement. Design, implement and improve environments across Microsoft 365, Azure, Entra ID, Intune, Windows Server, networking, security, backup and cloud services. Help customers improve their cybersecurity, governance and resilience, including ASD Essentials and ISO 27001-aligned initiatives . Identify opportunities to simplify, automate and continually improve customer environments. Mentor other engineers, share knowledge and help strengthen the capability of the wider Kodo team. You’ll work alongside Kodo’s engineers, leadership team, customers and technology partners to turn good advice into real outcomes. About You You’re technically strong, but you know great consulting is about more than knowing the answer. You listen well, ask good questions, explain complex ideas simply and take ownership of outcomes. You’re equally comfortable working through a difficult technical problem or sitting down with a customer to talk about where their technology needs to go next. You’ll bring: Demonstrated senior systems engineering experience, with the technical depth and judgement to work across complex customer environments . Strong Microsoft 365 and Azure experience, particularly Entra ID, Intune and Microsoft cloud services . Solid experience across Windows Server, networking, firewalls, backup and security technologies. Experience scoping, managing and delivering technical projects. Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to work through complex technical problems. A good understanding of cybersecurity, risk and modern governance practices. Experience using AI effectively, along with an understanding of its security and governance considerations. Excellent written and verbal communication. A current Australian driver’s licence. Microsoft certifications across Azure, Microsoft 365 or Security are highly regarded, as is experience with ASD Essentials, ISO 27001, PowerShell, automation and ITIL practices . But we’re just as interested in your judgement, curiosity and ability to work with people as we are in the technologies on your CV. Why Kodo? This isn’t a role where success is measured by how many tickets you close. You’ll have the opportunity to build meaningful customer relationships, tackle challenging technical problems and influence how organisations use technology. You’ll also get: Diverse customers and genuinely interesting projects. Exposure to modern cloud, cybersecurity and AI technologies. Professional development and certification support. A collaborative team where knowledge is shared. The opportunity to influence Kodo’s technical direction, standards and services. The lifestyle benefits of working in the Barossa Valley. The Person We’re Looking For Someone who can sit down with a business owner or leadership team, understand what matters to them, turn that conversation into a technology plan, and then work with the team to make it happen . If that sounds like you, we’d love to hear from you.
